newsitem.title: GEORGIA: Two Georgians held after seven people shot dead.
newsitem.headline: Two Georgians held after seven people shot dead.

text.p: Police detained two Georgian Interior Ministry soldiers on Tuesday after seven people, including four fellow servicemen, were killed in an apparent night-time shooting spree, a ministry spokesman said.

The spokesman said by telephone that Zurab Chkheidze, 20, was suspected of shooting dead four soldiers and one civilian at an oil depot in the village of Gamardzveba, 40 km (25 miles) southeast of the capital Tbilisi.
Chkheidze and the victims had been arguing before the shooting incident, the spokesman said.
Two other people were later shot dead in their car before Chkeidze and a second soldier, Petre Kakamidze, were apprehended at 5 a.m. (0100 GMT), two hours after the shooting began.
